elements.requirement: If a legal estate would not otherwise be vested in a person upon that person's entry in the register as the proprietor of that legal estate, the legal estate is deemed to be vested in that person as a result of the registration.
elements.quote: it shall be deemed to be vested in him as a result of the registration

elements.requirement: The statutory deemed vesting of a legal estate does not apply where the entry of a person in the register is made in pursuance of a registrable disposition in relation to which some other registration requirement remains to be met.
elements.quote: Subsection (1) does not apply where the entry is made in pursuance of a registrable disposition in relation to which some other registration requirement remains to be met
